caption:
Mistral has just launched its latest model, Mistral Large 4, also known as 'Le Chonk'. With a total of 1 trillion parameters, it sets a new standard in open-weight performance. The model is currently in public preview and aims to enhance performance across enterprise workloads.

The model will be available globally, focusing on sectors like cybersecurity, finance, and law. 680
